other_conditions: Only new Micro and Small Enterprises that commenced commercial production after the scheme’s launch are eligible
Units must be permanently registered with Entrepreneur Memorandum II by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Eligible units must belong to the “Green” list or the specified “Orange” list, excluding units covered under Orange II and II B
Units under a revival plan as defined in the sick unit revival policy are not eligible

The enterprise must have obtained a term loan and working capital from a nationalised bank, scheduled bank, co‑operative bank, Economic Development Corporation Ltd., or any other financial institution notified by the Government of Goa
The benefit is available for a period of five years (20 quarters) from the quarter in which commercial production started
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy of up to 1% of total net turnover or 30% of interest paid, whichever is lower, capped at ₹5,00,000 per annum for a period of five years.
documents_required: Specified proforma from the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
